pr_title: logical: rework how the change in plan is measured
pr_body: The prior implementation of MeasurePlanChange was inaccurate at calculating the change between the current plan and a proposed new plan. This led to the scenario where a node being added to a cluster wouldn't be considered for LDR. The change here reworks the calculation to be as follows: - Count all src dest pairs and count how many times each node is seen as a src and dest node - Do this for both the current plan and the proposed plan - Compare the current src nodes to the new src nodes and vice versa - Compare the current dest nodes to the new dest nodes and vice versa - Divide by the total number of pairs seen If this value is seen to be higher than the threshold cluster setting, trigger an ingestion retry and subsequent replan. Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/127022 Release note: none Proof from roachprod:

issue_context.title: ldr: job replanning doesn't replan on recovered nodes
issue_context.body:
In LDR resilience testing we found that when killing a node, the LDR job will not get replanned correctly to include the failed node (once it has recovered).  More details can be found [here](https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/C077F53B4KY/p1720621620620169).
